title: Hostage
text: It seems someone has sensed that we’re in hiding. Looking around, I sense a presence near our hideout—it looks like members of the Three Heroes Church have gathered and are casting Ceremonial Magic. I silently cast “Absorb.” My Father pulled out a message arrow and unfolded it.
“Um… To the False Spear Hero…?”
The Father slowly began to read the message on the arrow. After all, he’s already mastered the writing system of this world.
“Is this… are they out of their minds!?”
“What do you mean?”
The Father looked back and forth between the paper attached to the arrow and my face, looking troubled.
“To be honest, I don’t want to show you this. But… I think I have to let Motoyasu-kun see this.”

Just as my father muttered that, a barrage of “Judgment” rained down on the hideout. However, I nullified it, so nothing came of it. At the same time, I fired an Aiming Lancer, randomly striking targets in the nearby forest.

Well, that alone wouldn’t be enough to finish them off. So I unleashed a “Liberation Firestorm” and turned the area into a wasteland. Now that their hiding place has been exposed, it no longer serves any purpose as a hideout. My Father looks at the scorched forest, appearing slightly dumbfounded.
“I didn’t realize it since I can’t attack, but heroes really are… practically monsters, aren’t they?”
“That’s true. But Father’s Defense Power is on par with mine—to use your own words, you’re practically a monster yourself.”
“Actually, I’ve never even gotten a single scratch.”
“So, what exactly happened?”
“Well, first, I’d like you to take a look at this.”
With that, my Father unfolded the piece of paper attached to the arrow and showed it to me. When I saw the message written there, I was left speechless.
“To be honest, I think you shouldn’t go. It’s dangerous, even for someone like Motoyasu.”
My hand trembled as I clutched the paper, and a surge of anger welled up inside me.

――To the False Spear Hero. The Three Heroes Church has secured one hundred Filolial eggs. Among them are eggs that the demons had reserved for themselves. Come alone to the Dragon Hourglass in Melromarc at the specified date and time. Otherwise, we cannot guarantee the safety of the eggs. Resistance is futile.
To top it all off, they’d even sent a video crystal as proof that the eggs had been secured.
“Honestly, I have to admire how they came up with such a precise plan to lure Motoyasu-kun here.”
“We must go right away!”
“Wait! We have to stop the Siltvelt Army immediately. Is this… intentional? Summoning Motoyasu-kun at the very last moment before the Siltvelt Army retreats…”
“But I cannot abandon Filolial-sama’s eggs.”
“I know, but… Oh, for heaven’s sake! Does the Three Heroes Church really think they can defeat the Siltvelt Army!?”
“I suspect they believe that if they can just defeat my Father, everything will be resolved!”

I can feel my heart pounding harder. If we don’t hurry over there, Filolial-sama… the egg from which the future Filo-tan might be born will be destroyed. There’s no way I, Motoyasu, could ever let that happen.
“Luring us to the Dragon Hourglass… do you think there’s some ulterior motive?”
“Most likely, they’re trying to reset our levels and kill us for sure.”
“Ugh… You’re right—that’s definitely the surest way. I see. Well then, there’s absolutely no way I can let you go!”
“But I simply cannot abandon Filolial-sama’s egg.”
“But Motoyasu! Do you realize what’s happening? You’re going to be reset to Level 1!”
“Even so, I… will absolutely return alive!”
“…It seems the enemy knows Motoyasu’s personality inside and out.”
My Father declared this while running his fingers through his hair. But as for me, Motoyasu, there’s no way I can back down now.
“Anyway, Motoyasu, I’ll buy as much time as I can… so please wrap everything up quickly and come after me.”
“Understood!”
“Alright, I’m heading out now to stop the Siltvelt Army. So, the formation is—”
First, I’ll be heading to Melromarc alone. Yuki-chan and Kou plan to lie in wait near the Dragon Hourglass.
Next is my fiancée—Sakura-chan. She apparently said she’d go with me for the sake of the country, but Father ordered her to stand by.

To ensure Itsuki doesn’t escape from our current hideout, Rival and his Assistant will be staking it out. Thanks to the teleportation jam created by Rival and the spell-casting disruption from his Assistant, they say that even if Itsuki regains consciousness, he won’t be able to do anything. There was a plan to take Itsuki with me to the Dragon Hourglass, but since it was deemed too dangerous, we decided to have him stay behind.
Finally, there’s my Father and the remaining members. Keel and Luna-chan will accompany them. The whole group will gather at the hideout to discuss our next strategy.
“Melty-chan, listen carefully. The enemy already knows our location here. Make absolutely sure you don’t stray from Sakura-chan.”
“I understand… but I feel like I have to fight for the country, too.”
“I appreciate your feelings, but you’re a princess, and we can’t win unless we protect you. If Melty-chan dies, we’ve lost. So… I want you to stay here and protect yourself as much as possible.”
My father speaks in a gentle, admonishing tone, bending down to match his Finacée’s height. My future father speaks in a commanding, almost contemptuous tone.
“Honestly, I’d rather you were in Siltvelt, where you’re supposed to be in hiding… You… understand, right?”
“…Yeah. I get it.”
My future Father smiled and nodded. My Finacée’s cheeks are turning a bit red. What on earth is she daydreaming about?
“Sakura-chan, I’m counting on you to guard Melty-chan.”
“Got it. But will Naofumi be okay?”
“I’m the Shield Hero—all I can do is protect others. I’m confident I’ll survive.”
“I see. You absolutely can’t do anything reckless, okay?”
“Yeah, got it.”
Then my father turned to his Assistant.
“Wyndia, keep an eye on Itsuki with Gaelion.”
“Okay. I’ll interrupt them if they try to cast Magic.”
“I’m counting on you. Gaelion, you fend off any enemies trying to break into the hideout.”
“Got it! I’ll show them what Gaelion’s really made of!”
Then my father took a step toward us.
“Motoyasu, come as soon as you can. Just showing your strength and intimidating them should be enough to stop the Siltvelt Army in their tracks. I’ll try my best to persuade them, too.”
“Got it!”
“Yuki-chan and Kou, be careful too—though I think we’ll probably be fine.”
“No problem at all!”
“Kou, you’ve been kind of low-key lately, haven’t you?”
“Yeah, yeah.”
“Boo…”
“Ah… yeah, Elena, please at least put up a minimal fight.”
“Boo…”
“Huh? Oh, you mean it’s not dangerous?”
That Lazy Pig is saying something. I can’t make head or tail of it.
“Well, I could do it on the way there… but are you really sure it’ll be okay?”
“Boo.”
“That’s true. We can’t put Elena through any trouble. There’s no guarantee it’ll go well, after all.”
“Bububu.”
It seems my Father is having a conversation with the Lazy Pig. Judging by their exchange, is he taking the situation seriously enough to betray us?
“Well then, let’s get going!”
It looks like the Lazy Pig is tagging along with Father. What was that conversation all about, anyway?
“Motoyasu, this is the make-or-break moment. There’s a chance we can win, so do your absolute best.”
“Got it!”
And so, we decided to proceed as planned. I’m heading to the Dragon Hourglass in Melromarc, my Father is going to stop the advance on Siltvelt, and my Finacées are going to prevent Itsuki from dying.
